scientific_limitations: Only finite commutative Artinian local Gorenstein rings with radical cube zero, radical square nonzero and embedding dimension two; graph automorphisms not ring automorphisms. Bilinear form criterion is previously established in Kadu (2021); independent historical priority review is outstanding.
title: Complete ordinary zero-divisor graphs of short finite Gorenstein local rings
